<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>AFG Applicant Review</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#ffffff;--panel:#fff;--ink:#1c1c1a;--muted:#6b6a65;--line:#e4e2dc;--soft:#f3f4f6;
  --accent:#1f3a5f;--accent-ink:#fff;
  --new:#6b6a65;--short:#1f6fb2;--inter:#8a5a00;--hired:#2e7d4f;--rej:#b23b3b;
  --warn-bg:#fff3d6;--warn:#8a5a00;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:14px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans Armenian",sans-serif}
button,select,input,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 60px}
header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-size:20px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--muted)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.stat{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.stat.on{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.filters input[type=search]{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:180px}
.filters input,.filters select{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 2px 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.bulk{display:none;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px}
.bulk.show{display:flex}
.bulk select,.bulk button{background:transparent;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.bulk option{color:#000}
.tablewrap{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:1050px}
th,td{padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;vertical-align:middle}
th{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--panel);white-space:nowrap;user-select:none}
th.sort{cursor:pointer}th.sort:hover{color:var(--ink)}
tbody tr{cursor:pointer}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--soft)}
tbody tr.active{background:var(--soft);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--accent)}
.name{font-weight:600}
.small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-right:3px;white-space:nowrap}
.tag.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:transparent}
.yes{color:var(--hired);font-weight:600}.no{color:var(--muted)}
.st{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 6px;background:var(--panel);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.st[data-s=new]{color:var(--new)}.st[data-s=short]{color:var(--short)}.st[data-s=inter]{color:var(--inter)}.st[data-s=hired]{color:var(--hired)}.st[data-s=rej]{color:var(--rej)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}
.stars{color:#d49b1c;letter-spacing:1px;font-size:12px}
.noteic{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty{padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
.thumb{display:block;width:44px;height:58px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;object-fit:cover;object-position:top center;cursor:zoom-in}
.thumbtxt{position:relative;width:44px;height:58px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in}
.thumbtxt .mini{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:320px;transform:scale(.1375);transform-origin:top left;pointer-events:none}
.thumbtxt .mini .paper{box-shadow:none;border-radius:0;padding:14px 16px;font-size:9px}
.thumbno{width:44px;height:58px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);opacity:.35;font-size:15px}
/* drawer */
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:min(460px,100%);background:var(--panel);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12);transform:translateX(105%);transition:transform .2s;z-index:10;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.drawer.open{transform:none}
.dh{padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.dh h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}
.db{padding:14px 18px;overflow:auto;flex:1}
.x{border:none;background:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);line-height:1}
dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr;gap:6px 12px;margin:0 0 16px}
dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;padding-top:2px}
dd{margin:0;word-break:break-word}
.seg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.seg button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 11px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.rate{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-bottom:14px}
.rate button{border:none;background:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--line);padding:0 2px}
.rate button.on{color:#d49b1c}
textarea{width:100%;min-height:110px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;background:var(--bg);resize:vertical}
.lbl{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin:4px 0 6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.nav{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav .btn{flex:1}
a{color:var(--accent)}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none;z-index:20}
.toast.show{opacity:1}
.invite{background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.irow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.irow label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);gap:3px;flex:1}
.irow input{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px}
.irow .btn{padding:6px 10px}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
pre{white-space:pre-wrap;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin:6px 0 0}
.maprow{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.maprow img{width:150px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:zoom-in;flex:none}
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:30;padding:16px;cursor:zoom-out}
.lightbox.show{display:flex}.lightbox img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;border-radius:8px}
.wa{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:#1a8f4c;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
.wa svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:currentColor}
.btn.wa-btn{background:#1f9d55;border-color:#1f9d55;color:#fff}
.tag.src{background:#e8f0fb;color:#1f3a5f;border-color:transparent}
.hist{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);background:var(--soft);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:14px}
/* ---- CV features ---- */
.tag.cvt{background:#eaf5ee;color:#2e7d4f;border-color:transparent}
.cvbox{background:var(--soft);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.cvbox.drag{outline:2px dashed var(--accent);background:#eef3f9}
.cvfiles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.cvfile{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:12px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cvtxt{max-height:260px;overflow:auto;margin:0}
.cvrow{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.cvrow .btn{padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.cvrow .btn.primary{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.cvhint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.dropov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(31,58,95,.82);color:#fff;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:40;text-align:center;font-size:22px;font-weight:600;pointer-events:none}
.dropov.show{display:flex}
.dropov > div{border:3px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:18px;padding:40px 50px}
.dropov .small{color:#dfe7f1;font-weight:400;font-size:14px}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:35;padding:16px}
.modal.show{display:flex}
.mbox{background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;width:min(1100px,100%);max-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.mh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:10px}
.mbody{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;padding:14px 16px;overflow:auto;min-height:0;flex:1}
.mprev{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;min-height:420px;background:var(--soft);display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;overflow:auto}
.mprev iframe{width:100%;min-height:560px;border:0;background:#fff}
.mprev img{max-width:100%;object-fit:contain;align-self:flex-start}
.mprev .docx{background:#fff;padding:14px 18px;font-size:13px;width:100%;align-self:flex-start}
.mprev .none{align-self:center;color:var(--muted);padding:20px;text-align:center}
.mform{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.fgrid label,.mform > label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);gap:3px}
.fgrid input,.fgrid select,.mform textarea{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink)}
.fgrid .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.fgrid input.auto{background:#f2f8f3;border-color:#bfe0c8}
.mform textarea{min-height:70px}
.mf{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap}
.cvstatus{font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--soft)}
.cvstatus.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn)}
.cvdup{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:#fdeaea;color:var(--rej)}
.cvdup a{color:var(--rej);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:760px){.mbody{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mprev{min-height:260px}.mprev iframe{min-height:360px}}
/* ---- CV snapshot ---- */
.tag.cvt{cursor:zoom-in}
.tag.cvt:hover{background:#d6eedd}
.snapwrap{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#eceae4;padding:10px;cursor:zoom-in;max-height:430px;overflow:hidden}
.snapwrap:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:70px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(236,234,228,0),#eceae4)}
.snapwrap .snapmore{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:10px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:1;font-size:12px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:4px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
.paper{background:#fff;color:#1c1c1a;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12),0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.06);border-radius:3px;padding:22px 24px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;word-break:break-word}
.snapwrap .paper{font-size:11px;padding:16px 18px}
.paper .pn{font-size:1.6em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1.2;color:#1f3a5f}
.paper .ps{color:#6b6a65;margin-top:2px}
.paper .ph{margin:14px 0 5px;padding-bottom:3px;border-bottom:1.5px solid #1f3a5f;font-size:.82em;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1f3a5f;text-transform:uppercase}
.paper .pi{margin:5px 0 1px}.paper .pi b{font-weight:600}
.paper .pb{position:relative;padding-left:14px;margin:1px 0}
.paper .pb:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:.62em;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#1f3a5f;opacity:.7}
.paper .pp{margin:4px 0}
.paper .pnote{margin-top:14px;font-size:.88em;color:#8a8880;font-style:italic}
.snapflag{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);margin-bottom:8px}
.snapM .mbox{width:min(860px,100%);height:100%}
.snapM .sbody{flex:1;overflow:auto;background:#eceae4;padding:22px}
.snapM .paper{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;font-size:14px;padding:40px 46px;min-height:100%}
.snapM .mh .sub{font-weight:400}
.snapwrap.short:after{display:none}.snapwrap.short .snapmore{position:static;transform:none;display:inline-block;margin-top:8px}
.realwrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.realpg{max-width:100%;height:auto;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15),0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.07);border-radius:2px}
.snapM .realwrap .realpg{max-width:760px}
.docpaper img{max-width:160px}
.realthumb{padding:8px}
@media (max-width:760px){.snapM .sbody{padding:10px}.snapM .paper{padding:22px 18px;font-size:13px}}
</style>
<div class="wrap">
  <header>
    <div>
      <h1>AFG Retail Armenia — Applicant Review</h1>
      <div class="sub" id="sub"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="actions">
      <button class="btn" id="bCvDir" title="Pick the folder where you saved the CV attachments — each file is matched to its applicant automatically">📂 Load CV folder</button>
      <button class="btn primary" id="bAddCv" title="Add applicants from CV files (PDF, Word, image). You can also drag &amp; drop CVs anywhere on the page.">＋ Add CV</button>
      <button class="btn" id="bImport" title="Add a new Microsoft Forms export (.xlsx). Only new IDs are added.">⬆ Import Forms export</button>
      <button class="btn" id="bCsv">⬇ Export CSV</button>
      <button class="btn" id="bBackup" title="Save statuses, ratings and notes to a file">Backup</button>
      <button class="btn" id="bRestore">Restore</button>
      <input type="file" id="fImport" accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv" hidden>
      <input type="file" id="fRestore" accept=".json" hidden>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="stats" id="stats"></div>

  <div class="filters">
    <input type="search" id="q" placeholder="Search name, phone, address, email, languages…">
    <select id="fMall"><option value="">All malls</option></select>
    <select id="fPos"><option value="">All positions</option></select>
    <select id="fStatus"><option value="">All statuses</option></select>
    <select id="fEdu"><option value="">Any education</option></select>
    <select id="fExp"><option value="">Experience: any</option><option value="Այո">Has experience</option><option value="Ոչ">No experience</option></select>
    <select id="fWork"><option value="">Working now: any</option><option value="Ոչ">Not working now</option><option value="Այո">Working now</option></select>
    <select id="fId"><option value="">ID card: any</option><option value="Այո">Has ID card</option><option value="Ոչ">No ID card</option></select>
    <select id="fLang"><option value="">Languages: any</option><option value="ru">Russian</option><option value="en">English</option><option value="ruen">Russian + English</option></select>
    <select id="fAge"><option value="">Age: any</option><option value="18">18+</option><option value="u18">Under 18</option><option value="unk">Age unknown</option></select>
    <select id="fDate"><option value="">Any date</option><option value="7">Last 7 days</option><option value="14">Last 14 days</option><option value="30">Last 30 days</option></select>
    <select id="fSrc"><option value="">Source: any</option><option value="forms">Microsoft Forms</option><option value="email">Email</option><option value="nophone">Email · no phone yet</option><option value="cv">Added from CV file</option><option value="hascv">Has CV</option><option value="nocv">No CV</option></select>
    <button class="btn" id="bReset">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <div class="bar">
    <span id="count"></span>
    <div class="bulk" id="bulk">
      <span id="selN"></span>
      <select id="bulkSt"><option value="">Set status…</option></select>
      <button id="bulkPhones">Copy phones</button>
      <button id="bulkMail" title="One Outlook email to all selected, addresses in BCC, sent from hr.armenia@afgretail.com with the map included.">✉ Invite (BCC)</button>
      <button id="bulkClear">Clear</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="tablewrap">
    <table>
      <thead><tr>
        <th><input type="checkbox" id="all"></th>
        <th>CV</th>
        <th class="sort" data-k="n">Name</th>
        <th class="sort" data-k="age">Age</th>
        <th>Phone</th>
        <th>Mall</th>
        <th>Position</th>
        <th>Education</th>
        <th>Exp.</th>
        <th>Working</th>
        <th>ID</th>
        <th>Lang.</th>
        <th class="sort" data-k="t">Applied</th>
        <th>Status</th>
        <th></th>
      </tr></thead>
      <tbody id="tb"></tbody>
    </table>
    <div class="empty" id="empty" hidden>No applicants match these filters.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<aside class="drawer" id="dr">
  <div class="dh"><div><h2 id="dName"></h2><div class="small" id="dMeta"></div></div><button class="x" id="dClose" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>
  <div class="db">
    <div id="dHist"></div>
    <div class="lbl">Status</div><div class="seg" id="dSeg"></div>
    <div class="lbl">Rating</div><div class="rate" id="dRate"></div>
    <dl id="dl"></dl>
    <div id="dCv"></div>
    <div class="lbl">Interview invitation</div>
    <div class="invite">
      <div class="irow"><label>Date<input type="date" id="iDate"></label><label>Time<input type="time" id="iTime" step="900"></label></div>
      <div class="irow"><label style="flex:1">Send from<input type="email" id="iFrom" placeholder="empty = your own Outlook mailbox" style="width:100%"></label></div>
      <div class="small" id="iTo"></div>
      <div class="small" id="iFallback" hidden style="margin-top:4px"></div>
      <div class="irow"><button class="btn primary" id="iOutlook">✉ Open in Outlook</button><button class="btn" id="iWeb" title="Outlook on the web (outlook.office.com)">Outlook Web</button><button class="btn" id="iCopy">Copy text</button><button class="btn wa-btn" id="iWa" title="Send the same invitation on WhatsApp">WhatsApp invite</button></div>
      <div class="maprow">
        <img id="iMap" alt="Map to AFG Retail office" title="Click to enlarge">
        <div class="small">The map is added to the email automatically. Sender: <b>hr.armenia@afgretail.com</b><br><button class="btn" id="iMapCopy" style="margin-top:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px">Copy map image</button></div>
      </div>
      <label class="small" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px">Google Maps link in the email
        <input id="iLink" style="border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px" placeholder="Paste the Share link of the office pin"></label>
      <details><summary class="small">Preview email</summary><pre id="iPrev"></pre></details>
    </div>
    <div class="lbl">Notes</div>
    <textarea id="dNote" placeholder="Interview impressions, availability, preferred brand…"></textarea>
  </div>
  <div class="nav"><button class="btn" id="dPrev">← Previous</button><button class="btn" id="dNext">Next →</button></div>
</aside>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
<div class="dropov" id="dropOv"><div>Drop CV files to add applicants<br><span class="small">PDF · Word (.docx) · image · text — several at once is fine</span></div></div>
<div class="modal" id="cvM" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
  <div class="mbox">
    <div class="mh"><b>New applicant from CV <span class="small" id="cvQ"></span></b><button class="x" id="cvX" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>
    <div class="mbody">
      <div class="mprev" id="cvPrev"></div>
      <div class="mform">
        <div class="cvstatus" id="cvStatus"></div>
        <div id="cvDup"></div>
        <div class="fgrid">
          <label class="wide">Name<input id="cf_n"></label>
          <label>Phone<input id="cf_p"></label>
          <label>Email<input id="cf_e"></label>
          <label>Date of birth / year<input id="cf_b" placeholder="dd.mm.yyyy or year"></label>

const CV_SNAP={"100394": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"], "100396": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"], "100400": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"], "100401": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"], "100402": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"], "100404": ["data:image/jpeg;base64,"]};

const LS_REV='cenomi-applicants-review-v1', LS_EXTRA='cenomi-applicants-extra-v1';
const STATUSES=[['new','New'],['short','Shortlisted'],['inter','Group interview'],['hired','Hired'],['rej','Rejected']];
const STL=Object.fromEntries(STATUSES);
const MALL={'Երևան Մոլ':'Yerevan Mall','Դալմա Մոլ':'Dalma Mall','Մեգա Մոլ Արմենիա':'Mega Mall'};
const POS={'Վաճառող խորհրդատու (կես դրույք)':'Sales Consultant · part-time','Վաճառող խորհրդատու (ամբողջական դրույք)':'Sales Consultant · full-time','Սրահի պատասխանատու':'Floor Supervisor','Այլ հաստիքի ակնկալիք ունեմ':'Other position'};
const EDU={'Համալսարան':'University','Քոլեջ':'College','Դպրոց':'School'};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
function load(k,d){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))||d}catch(e){return d}}
function save(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch(e){}if(k===LS_REV||k===LS_EXTRA)queueShared()}
let rev=load(LS_REV,{}), extra=load(LS_EXTRA,[]);
let data=[], view=[], sel=new Set(), cur=null, sortK='t', sortDir=-1, statFilter=null;
const NOW=new Date(), THIS_YEAR=NOW.getFullYear();

function birthYear(b){
  if(!b)return null;
  let m=b.match(/(19[4-9]\d|20[0-2]\d)/); if(m)return +m[1];
  m=b.match(/(\d{2})\D*$/); if(m){let y=+m[1]; return y<=THIS_YEAR%100?2000+y:1900+y}
  return null;
}
const phoneKey=p=>String(p).replace(/\D/g,'').slice(-8);
// WhatsApp: normalise Armenian numbers (0XX XXXXXX / 8 digits) to 374XXXXXXXX
function waNum(p){let d=String(p||'').replace(/\D/g,'');if(d.startsWith('00'))d=d.slice(2);
  if(d.length===9&&d[0]==='0')d='374'+d.slice(1);else if(d.length===8)d='374'+d;
  return d.length>=10&&d.length<=15?d:''}
const WA_ICON='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 0-8.6 15.1L2 22l5-1.3A10 10 0 1 0 12 2zm0 18.2a8.2 8.2 0 0 1-4.2-1.2l-.3-.2-3 .8.8-2.9-.2-.3A8.2 8.2 0 1 1 12 20.2zm4.5-6.1c-.2-.1-1.5-.7-1.7-.8s-.4-.1-.6.1-.7.8-.8 1-.3.2-.5.1a6.7 6.7 0 0 1-3.3-2.9c-.3-.4.2-.4.7-1.3.1-.2 0-.3 0-.4l-.8-1.8c-.2-.5-.4-.4-.6-.4h-.5a1 1 0 0 0-.7.3 3 3 0 0 0-.9 2.2 5.2 5.2 0 0 0 1.1 2.8 11.9 11.9 0 0 0 4.6 4c1.7.7 2.4.8 3.2.7.5-.1 1.5-.6 1.8-1.2s.2-1.1.1-1.2l-.4-.2z"/></svg>';
const WA_HELLO='Բարև Ձեզ, գրում ենք AFG Retail Armenia-ից՝ Ձեր աշխատանքի դիմումի վերաբերյալ։';
const waLink=(p,text)=>{const n=waNum(p);return n?`https://wa.me/${n}${text?'?text='+encodeURIComponent(text):''}`:''};
function langs(l){const s=l.toLowerCase(),o=[];
  if(/ռուս|rus|рус/.test(s))o.push('RU');
  if(/անգլ|angl|engl|eng\b|англ/.test(s))o.push('EN');
  if(/ֆրանս|fran|фран/.test(s))o.push('FR');
  if(/գերմ|germ|deut|нем/.test(s))o.push('DE');
  if(/իսպ|span|исп/.test(s))o.push('ES');
  if(/պարս|pars|pers|фарс/.test(s))o.push('FA');
  return o}
function prep(){
  const seen=new Set(), all=[];
  for(const r of [...BASE,...extra]){if(seen.has(r.id))continue;seen.add(r.id);all.push({...r})}
  const byPhone={};
  for(const r of all){r.by=birthYear(r.b);r.age=r.by?THIS_YEAR-r.by:null;r.L=langs(r.l);r.pk=phoneKey(r.p);(byPhone[r.pk]=byPhone[r.pk]||[]).push(r)}
  const byMail={};const mk=r=>String(r.e||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  for(const r of all){const k=mk(r);if(k.includes('@'))(byMail[k]=byMail[k]||[]).push(r)}
  for(const r of all){const s=new Set(r.pk.length>=8?byPhone[r.pk]:[]);const k=mk(r);if(k.includes('@'))byMail[k].forEach(x=>s.add(x));s.delete(r);r.dups=[...s]}
  data=all;
}
const R=id=>rev[id]||{};
const st=r=>R(r.id).s||'new';
function setRev(id,patch){rev[id]={...R(id),...patch};save(LS_REV,rev)}
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
function toast(m){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(t._t);t._t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1800)}

function fillSelects(){
  const opt=(el,vals,lab)=>{const keep=el.value;el.length=1;vals.forEach(v=>el.add(new Option(lab(v),v)));el.value=keep};
  const uniq=f=>[...new Set(data.map(f))].sort((a,b)=>data.filter(r=>f(r)===b).length-data.filter(r=>f(r)===a).length);
  opt($('fMall'),uniq(r=>r.m),v=>MALL[v]||v);
  opt($('fPos'),uniq(r=>r.pos),v=>POS[v]||v);
  opt($('fEdu'),['University','College','School','Other'],v=>v);
  if($('fStatus').length===1)STATUSES.forEach(([k,l])=>{$('fStatus').add(new Option(l,k));$('bulkSt').add(new Option(l,k))});
}
const eduCat=r=>EDU[r.ed]||'Other';

function apply(){
  const src=$('fSrc').value, q=$('q').value.trim().toLowerCase(), f={m:$('fMall').value,pos:$('fPos').value,s:$('fStatus').value,ed:$('fEdu').value,x:$('fExp').value,w:$('fWork').value,idc:$('fId').value,l:$('fLang').value,a:$('fAge').value,d:+$('fDate').value};
  view=data.filter(r=>{
    if(f.m&&r.m!==f.m)return false; if(f.pos&&r.pos!==f.pos)return false; if(f.s&&st(r)!==f.s)return false;
    if(f.ed&&eduCat(r)!==f.ed)return false; if(f.x&&r.x!==f.x)return false; if(f.w&&r.w!==f.w)return false; if(f.idc&&r.idc!==f.idc)return false;
    if(f.l==='ru'&&!r.L.includes('RU'))return false; if(f.l==='en'&&!r.L.includes('EN'))return false; if(f.l==='ruen'&&!(r.L.includes('RU')&&r.L.includes('EN')))return false;
    if(f.a==='18'&&!(r.age>=18))return false; if(f.a==='u18'&&!(r.age!==null&&r.age<18))return false; if(f.a==='unk'&&r.age!==null)return false;
    if(f.d&&(NOW-new Date(r.t.replace(' ','T')))/864e5>f.d)return false;
    if(src==='forms'&&r.src)return false; if(src==='cv'&&r.src!=='cv')return false; if(src==='hascv'&&!hasCv(r))return false; if(src==='nocv'&&hasCv(r))return false; if(src==='email'&&r.src!=='email')return false; if(src==='nophone'&&!(r.src==='email'&&!waNum(r.p)))return false;
    if(statFilter&&!statFilter(r))return false;
    if(q){const hay=[r.n,r.p,r.a,r.e,r.l,r.ed,r.en,R(r.id).note,r.cv&&r.cv.text,CV_FULL[r.id],r.cvLocal&&r.cvLocal.text].join(' ').toLowerCase();if(!hay.includes(q)&&!(q.replace(/\D/g,'').length>=4&&r.pk.includes(q.replace(/\D/g,''))))return false}
    return true});
  view.sort((a,b)=>{let x=a[sortK],y=b[sortK];if(x==null)return 1;if(y==null)return -1;return (x>y?1:x<y?-1:0)*sortDir});
  render();
}

function stats(){
  const wk=data.filter(r=>(NOW-new Date(r.t.replace(' ','T')))/864e5<=7).length;
  const cards=[
    ['Total applicants',data.length,null],
    ['Last 7 days',wk,r=>(NOW-new Date(r.t.replace(' ','T')))/864e5<=7],
    ...Object.entries(MALL).map(([k,v])=>[v,data.filter(r=>r.m===k).length,r=>r.m===k]),
    ['Not reviewed',data.filter(r=>st(r)==='new').length,r=>st(r)==='new'],
    ['Shortlisted / interview',data.filter(r=>['short','inter'].includes(st(r))).length,r=>['short','inter'].includes(st(r))],
    ['Hired',data.filter(r=>st(r)==='hired').length,r=>st(r)==='hired'],
    ['From email',data.filter(r=>r.src==='email').length,r=>r.src==='email'],
    ['With CV',data.filter(hasCv).length,hasCv],
  ];
  $('stats').innerHTML=cards.map((c,i)=>`<div class="stat${statFilter&&statFilter._i===i?' on':''}" data-i="${i}"><b>${c[1]}</b><span>${c[0]}</span></div>`).join('');
  $('stats').querySelectorAll('.stat').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>{const c=cards[+el.dataset.i];if(!c[2]||(statFilter&&statFilter._i===+el.dataset.i))statFilter=null;else{statFilter=c[2];statFilter._i=+el.dataset.i}apply()});
  const ts=data.map(r=>r.t).sort();
  $('sub').textContent=`${data.length} applications · ${ts[0]?.slice(0,10)} → ${ts.at(-1)?.slice(0,10)} · ${SYNC_TXT()}`;
}

function thumbHtml(r){
  const t=r.cvLocal&&r.cvLocal.thumb;
  if(!t&&CV_SNAP[r.id])return `<img class="thumb cvt" src="${CV_SNAP[r.id][0]}" alt="CV" title="CV snapshot — click to enlarge" loading="lazy">`;
  if(t)return `<img class="thumb cvt" src="${t}" alt="CV" title="CV snapshot — click to enlarge" loading="lazy">`;
  const src=(typeof cvSnapSource==='function')?cvSnapSource(r):null;
  if(src&&src.text)return `<div class="thumbtxt cvt" title="CV snapshot — click to enlarge"><div class="mini">${cvPaper(src.text,r.n)}</div></div>`;
  if(hasCv(r))return `<div class="thumbtxt cvt" title="CV snapshot — click to enlarge"><div class="mini">${cvPaper('CV attached — open the email to view',r.n)}</div></div>`;
  return '<div class="thumbno" title="No CV">—</div>';
}
function render(){
  stats();
  $('count').textContent=`${view.length} of ${data.length} shown`;
  $('empty').hidden=view.length>0;
  document.querySelectorAll('th.sort').forEach(th=>{th.textContent=th.textContent.replace(/ [▲▼]$/,'')+(th.dataset.k===sortK?(sortDir>0?' ▲':' ▼'):'')});
  const yn=v=>v==='Այո'?'<span class="yes">Yes</span>':v==='Ոչ'?'<span class="no">No</span>':'<span class="small">—</span>';
  $('tb').innerHTML=view.map(r=>{const rv=R(r.id),s=st(r);return `<tr data-id="${r.id}" class="${cur===r.id?'active':''}">
    <td onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><input type="checkbox" class="ck" ${sel.has(r.id)?'checked':''}></td>
    <td>${thumbHtml(r)}</td>
    <td><div class="name">${esc(r.n)}</div>${r.src==='email'?'<span class="tag src" title="Applied by email to hr.armenia">✉ Email</span>':''}${r.src==='cv'?'<span class="tag src" title="Added from a CV file">⬆ CV file</span>':''}${hasCv(r)?'<span class="tag cvt" title="Click to see the CV snapshot">📄 CV</span>':''}${r.dups.length?`<span class="tag warn" title="Same phone or email as another application">Applied ${r.dups.length+1}×</span>`:''}</td>
    <td>${r.age??'<span class="small">—</span>'}${r.age!==null&&r.age<18?' <span class="tag warn">U18</span>':''}</td>
    <td class="small" style="white-space:nowrap" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">${r.p?esc(r.p):'<span class="small">—</span>'} ${waNum(r.p)?`<a class="wa" href="${waLink(r.p,WA_HELLO)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open WhatsApp chat">${WA_ICON}</a>`:''}</td>
    <td>${esc(MALL[r.m]||r.m)}</td>
    <td>${esc(POS[r.pos]||r.pos)}</td>
    <td>${r.ed?esc(eduCat(r)):'<span class="small">—</span>'}</td>
    <td>${yn(r.x)}</td><td>${yn(r.w)}</td><td>${yn(r.idc)}</td>
    <td>${r.L.map(x=>`<span class="tag">${x}</span>`).join('')}</td>
    <td class="small" style="white-space:nowrap">${r.t.slice(0,10)}</td>
    <td onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><select class="st" data-s="${s}">${STATUSES.map(([k,l])=>`<option value="${k}" ${k===s?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></td>
    <td>${rv.r?`<span class="stars">${'★'.repeat(rv.r)}</span>`:''} ${rv.note?'<span class="noteic" title="Has notes">✎</span>':''}</td>
  </tr>`}).join('');
  $('all').checked=view.length&&view.every(r=>sel.has(r.id));
  $('bulk').classList.toggle('show',sel.size>0);$('selN').textContent=`${sel.size} selected`;
}

$('tb').addEventListener('click',e=>{const tr=e.target.closest('tr');if(tr)openDr(+tr.dataset.id)});
$('tb').addEventListener('change',e=>{const id=+e.target.closest('tr').dataset.id;
  if(e.target.classList.contains('ck')){e.target.checked?sel.add(id):sel.delete(id);render()}
  if(e.target.classList.contains('st')){setRev(id,{s:e.target.value});toast(`Status → ${STL[e.target.value]}`);render();if(cur===id)openDr(id)}});
$('all').onchange=e=>{view.forEach(r=>e.target.checked?sel.add(r.id):sel.delete(r.id));render()};
$('bulkSt').onchange=e=>{if(!e.target.value)return;sel.forEach(id=>setRev(id,{s:e.target.value}));toast(`${sel.size} set to ${STL[e.target.value]}`);e.target.value='';apply()};
$('bulkPhones').onclick=()=>{const t=data.filter(r=>sel.has(r.id)).map(r=>`${r.n}\t${r.p}`).join('\n');navigator.clipboard?.writeText(t).then(()=>toast('Names + phones copied'),()=>toast('Copy failed'))};
$('bulkClear').onclick=()=>{sel.clear();render()};
document.querySelectorAll('th.sort').forEach(th=>th.onclick=()=>{const k=th.dataset.k;if(sortK===k)sortDir*=-1;else{sortK=k;sortDir=k==='t'?-1:1}apply()});
['q','fMall','fPos','fStatus','fEdu','fExp','fWork','fId','fLang','fAge','fDate','fSrc'].forEach(id=>$(id).addEventListener('input',apply));
$('bReset').onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.filters input,.filters select').forEach(el=>el.value='');statFilter=null;apply()};

function openDr(id){
  cur=id;const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id),rv=R(id),s=st(r);
  $('dName').textContent=r.n;
  $('dMeta').textContent=`#${r.id} · applied ${r.t}`;
  $('dHist').innerHTML=r.dups.length?`<div class="hist">Also applied with this phone: ${r.dups.map(d=>`<a href="#" data-id="${d.id}">${esc(d.n)} (${d.t.slice(0,10)}, ${esc(MALL[d.m]||d.m)})</a>`).join(', ')}</div>`:'';
  $('dHist').querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();openDr(+a.dataset.id)});
  $('dSeg').innerHTML=STATUSES.map(([k,l])=>`<button data-k="${k}" class="${k===s?'on':''}">${l}</button>`).join('');
  $('dSeg').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{setRev(id,{s:b.dataset.k});openDr(id);apply()});
  $('dRate').innerHTML=[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<button data-n="${n}" class="${(rv.r||0)>=n?'on':''}" title="${n}/5">★</button>`).join('');
  $('dRate').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const n=+b.dataset.n;setRev(id,{r:rv.r===n?0:n});openDr(id);render()});
  const tel=r.p.replace(/[^\d+]/g,'');
  const wa=waLink(r.p,WA_HELLO);
  const yn2=v=>v==='Այո'?'Yes':v==='Ոչ'?'No':'—';
  const rows=[...(r.src==='email'?[['Source','✉ Email to hr.armenia'+(r.en?`<div class="small">${esc(r.en)}</div>`:'')]]:r.src==='cv'?[['Source','⬆ CV file'+(r.en?`<div class="small">${esc(r.en)}</div>`:'')]]:[]),
    ['Phone',r.p?`<a href="tel:${esc(tel)}">${esc(r.p)}</a> <button class="btn" style="padding:1px 7px;font-size:12px" id="cp">Copy</button>${wa?` <a class="btn wa-btn" style="padding:1px 8px;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none" href="${wa}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">WhatsApp</a>`:''}`:'<span class="small">Not in email — check the CV in Outlook</span>'],['Mall',esc(MALL[r.m]||r.m)],['Position',`${esc(POS[r.pos]||r.pos)}<div class="small">${esc(r.pos)}</div>`],
    ['Date of birth',`${esc(r.b)||'—'}${r.age!==null?` <span class="small">(≈${r.age} y.o.)</span>`:''}`],['Address',esc(r.a)],['Email',r.e?`<a href="mailto:${esc(r.e)}">${esc(r.e)}</a>`:'—'],
    ['Education',esc(r.ed)||'—'],['Work experience',yn2(r.x)],['Working now',yn2(r.w)],['ID card',yn2(r.idc)],['Languages',esc(r.l)||'—']];
  $('dl').innerHTML=rows.map(([k,v])=>`<dt>${k}</dt><dd>${v}</dd>`).join('');
  if($('cp'))$('cp').onclick=()=>navigator.clipboard?.writeText(r.p).then(()=>toast('Phone copied'));
  $('dNote').value=rv.note||'';
  $('dr').classList.add('open');render();
}
$('dNote').addEventListener('input',e=>{if(cur!=null){setRev(cur,{note:e.target.value})}});
$('dNote').addEventListener('blur',render);
$('dClose').onclick=()=>{$('dr').classList.remove('open');cur=null;render()};
function step(d){const i=view.findIndex(r=>r.id===cur);const n=view[i+d];if(n)openDr(n.id)}
$('dPrev').onclick=()=>step(-1);$('dNext').onclick=()=>step(1);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.matches('input,textarea,select'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')$('dClose').click();if(cur!=null&&(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='j')){e.preventDefault();step(1)}if(cur!=null&&(e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='k')){e.preventDefault();step(-1)}});

let _dl=null;(async()=>{try{if(window.claude&&claude.use)_dl=await claude.use('downloads')}catch(e){}})();
async function saveBlob(name,blob,quiet){
  if(_dl){
    try{await _dl.save({filename:name,data:blob});return 'saved'}
    catch(e){const c=e&&e.code;
      if(c==='declined')return 'declined';
      if(c==='rejected_extension'||c==='extension_not_enabled')return 'refused';
      if(!quiet)toast('Could not save file');return 'failed'}
  }
  const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);return 'saved';
}
function download(name,text,type){saveBlob(name,new Blob([text],{type}))}
const stamp=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

const COLS={id:'ID',t:'Start time',n:'Անուն Ազգանուն',b:'Ծննդյան տարեթիվ',p:'Հեռախոսահամար',m:'Ընտրեք Մոլը',a:'Բնակության Վայր/Փաստացի բնակության հասցե',e:'Էլ. Հասցե/E-mail',ed:'Կրթություն',pos:'Ո՞ր հաստիքի համար եք դիմում',x:'Աշխատանքային փորձ',w:'Ներկա պահին աշխատում ե՞ք',l:'Լեզուների իմացություն',idc:'ID Քարտի առկայություն'};
$('bImport').onclick=()=>{if(typeof XLSX==='undefined'){toast('Import needs an internet connection');return}$('fImport').click()};
$('fImport').onchange=async e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;
  try{const wb=XLSX.read(await f.arrayBuffer(),{cellDates:true});const rows=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]],{defval:''});
    if(!rows.length||!(COLS.n in rows[0]))throw new Error('cols');
    const have=new Set(data.map(r=>r.id));let added=0;
    const fmt=v=>v instanceof Date?`${v.getFullYear()}-${String(v.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(v.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(v.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(v.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`:String(v).slice(0,16);
    for(const row of rows){const id=+row[COLS.id];if(!id||have.has(id))continue;const o={id};
      for(const [k,c] of Object.entries(COLS)){if(k==='id')continue;let v=row[c];o[k]=k==='t'?fmt(v):(v instanceof Date?v.toLocaleDateString('en-GB').replace(/\//g,'.'):String(v??'').trim())}
      extra.push(o);have.add(id);added++}
    save(LS_EXTRA,extra);prep();fillSelects();apply();toast(added?`Added ${added} new applicant${added>1?'s':''}`:'No new applicants in this file');
  }catch(err){toast('Could not read this file — use the Forms .xlsx export')}e.target.value=''};

const fmtDate=d=>d?d.split('-').reverse().join('.'):'';
function mailBody(){return `Ողջույն,

Շնորհակալ ենք AFG Retail Armenia դիմելու համար. Հաճույքով հրավիրում ենք Ձեզ կարճ հարցազրույցի համար.
Հարցազրույցի օր՝ ${fmtDate($('iDate').value)}
Ժամը՝ ${$('iTime').value}
Հասցե Ծիծեռնակաբերդի խճուղի 1/3${$('iLink').value.trim()?`
Քարտեզ՝ ${$('iLink').value.trim()}`:''}
Խնդրում ենք պատասխան նամակով հաստատել Ձեր մասնակցությունը
Հասնելուն պես զանգահարեք +37455500674


Հարգանքով,
HR թիմ — AFG Retail Armenia`}
const cleanEmail=e=>{const m=String(e||'').replace(/\s+/g,'').match(/[^@\s,;]+@[^@\s,;]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i);return m?m[0]:''};
function updInvite(){
  if(cur==null)return;const r=data.find(x=>x.id===cur),em=cleanEmail(r.e);
  $('iWa').disabled=!waNum(r.p);
  $('iTo').innerHTML=(em?`To: <b>${esc(em)}</b>`:'<span style="color:var(--rej)">No valid email in the application — use WhatsApp or call.</span>')+(waNum(r.p)?'':' <span class="small">· no phone for WhatsApp</span>');
  ['iOutlook','iWeb'].forEach(id=>$(id).disabled=!em);
  $('iPrev').textContent=mailBody();
}
function checkDT(){if(!$('iDate').value||!$('iTime').value){toast('Set the interview date and time first');return false}return true}
function markInvited(ids){const note=`Invited to interview ${fmtDate($('iDate').value)} ${$('iTime').value}`;
  ids.forEach(id=>{const rv=R(id),s=rv.s||'new';const n=rv.note||'';setRev(id,{s:(s==='new'||s==='short')?'inter':s,note:n.includes(note)?n:(n?n+'\n':'')+note})});
  if(cur!=null&&ids.includes(cur))openDr(cur);apply()}
const enc=encodeURIComponent;
function openUrl(u){
  let w=null;try{w=window.open(u,'_blank','noopener')}catch(e){}
  if(w)return true;
  try{const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';a.style.display='none';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();}catch(e){}
  showFallbackLink(u);
  return false;
}
function showFallbackLink(u){
  const box=$('iFallback');if(!box)return;
  box.innerHTML=`<a href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">If nothing opened, click here to open the email</a> · <button class="btn" id="iCopyLink" type="button">Copy link</button>`;
  box.hidden=false;
  const b=$('iCopyLink');if(b)b.onclick=()=>{navigator.clipboard?.writeText(u).then(()=>toast('Link copied'),()=>toast('Copy failed'))};
}
let FROM=(()=>{try{const v=localStorage.getItem('cenomi-from');return v===null?'hr.armenia@afgretail.com':v}catch(e){return 'hr.armenia@afgretail.com'}})().trim();
function showBccList(bcc){
  const box=$('iFallback');if(!box)return;
  box.innerHTML=`<b>Outlook Web can't pre-fill Bcc.</b> The addresses are copied — paste them into the Bcc field (Ctrl+V).<br><textarea id="iBccTxt" readonly rows="2" style="width:100%;margin-top:4px">${esc(bcc)}</textarea>`;
  box.hidden=false;
  navigator.clipboard?.writeText(bcc).catch(()=>{});
  const t=$('iBccTxt');if(t)t.onclick=()=>t.select();
}
function sendMail(web,to,bcc){
  const body=mailBody().replace(/\n/g,'\r\n');
  if(bcc)showBccList(bcc);
  openUrl(`https://outlook.office.com/mail/${FROM?enc(FROM)+'/':''}deeplink/compose?${to?'to='+enc(to)+'&':''}${bcc?'bcc='+enc(bcc)+'&':''}subject=${enc(SUBJECT)}&body=${enc(body)}`);
}
// Desktop Outlook: build a ready draft (.eml) with From, To/BCC, text and the map image already inside
const b64u=t=>btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(t)));
const wrap76=t=>t.replace(/.{1,76}/g,'$&\r\n');
function buildEml(to,bcc){
  const B='=_cenomi_'+Date.now();
  const link=$('iLink').value.trim();
  let html=esc(mailBody()).replace(/\n/g,'<br>\n');
  if(link)html=html.replace(esc(link),`<a href="${esc(link)}">${esc(link)}</a>`);
  html=`<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body style="font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11pt">${html}<br><br><img src="cid:cenomimap" alt="Map" width="500" style="max-width:100%;border-radius:6px"></body></html>`;
  const H=[FROM?`From: ${FROM}`:'',to?`To: ${to}`:'',bcc?`Bcc: ${bcc}`:'',`Subject: =?UTF-8?B?${b64u(SUBJECT)}?=`,'X-Unsent: 1','MIME-Version: 1.0',`Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="${B}"`].filter(Boolean);
  return H.join('\r\n')+'\r\n\r\n'+
    `--${B}\r\nContent-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64\r\n\r\n${wrap76(b64u(html))}`+
    `--${B}\r\nContent-Type: image/png; name="map.png"\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64\r\nContent-ID: <cenomimap>\r\nContent-Disposition: inline; filename="map.png"\r\n\r\n${wrap76(MAP_SRC.split(',')[1])}`+
    `--${B}--\r\n`;
}
async function openDesktop(to,bcc,name){
  const fn=`Invitation${name?' - '+name.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g,''):''}`;
  const eml=buildEml(to,bcc);
  const r=await saveBlob(fn+'.eml',new Blob([eml],{type:'message/rfc822'}),true);
  if(r==='saved'){toast('Email ready — open the downloaded file to launch Outlook');return}
  if(r==='declined')return;
  toast('Outlook files can\'t be saved here — opening Outlook Web instead');
  sendMail(true,to,bcc);
}

$('iWa').onclick=()=>{if(!checkDT())return;const r=data.find(x=>x.id===cur);const l=waLink(r.p,mailBody().replace('Խնդրում ենք պատասխան նամակով հաստատել','Խնդրում ենք պատասխանել այս հաղորդագրությանը՝ հաստատելով'));if(!l){toast('No phone number for WhatsApp');return}openUrl(l);markInvited([cur]);toast('WhatsApp opened — press Send')};
$('iCopy').onclick=()=>{if(!checkDT())return;navigator.clipboard?.writeText(mailBody()).then(()=>toast('Email text copied'))};
$('bulkMail').onclick=()=>{
  if(!$('iDate').value||!$('iTime').value){toast('Open any applicant and set date & time in the invitation panel first');return}
  const rs=data.filter(r=>sel.has(r.id)),ok=rs.filter(r=>cleanEmail(r.e));
