  sendMail(true,'',list);toast(`Draft opened for ${ok.length} — paste the addresses into Bcc`+tail)};
const _open=openDr;openDr=function(id){_open(id);updInvite()};

// ================= CVs: email CVs + drag-and-drop CV import =================
const CV_LS='cenomi-cv-local-v1';
let CVL=load(CV_LS,{});                      // id -> {name,type,size,text,date}
const hasCv=r=>!!(r.cv||r.cvLocal);
const CDN={
  pdf:['https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@3.11.174/build/pdf.min.js'],
  pdfw:['https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@3.11.174/build/pdf.worker.min.js'],
  docx:['https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mammoth/1.8.0/mammoth.browser.min.js','https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mammoth@1.8.0/mammoth.browser.min.js']
};
function loadScript(urls){return new Promise((res,rej)=>{let i=0;const next=()=>{if(i>=urls.length)return rej(new Error('Could not load '+urls[0]));const s=document.createElement('script');s.src=urls[i++];s.onload=()=>res();s.onerror=()=>{s.remove();next()};document.head.appendChild(s)};next()})}
let _pdfReady=null,_docxReady=null;
function ensurePdf(){return _pdfReady||(_pdfReady=(async()=>{
  if(!window.pdfjsLib)await loadScript(CDN.pdf);
  for(const u of CDN.pdfw){try{const r=await fetch(u);if(!r.ok)continue;const t=await r.text();pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([t],{type:'text/javascript'}));return}catch(e){}}
  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc=CDN.pdfw[0];
})().catch(e=>{_pdfReady=null;throw e}))}
function ensureDocx(){return _docxReady||(_docxReady=(window.mammoth?Promise.resolve():loadScript(CDN.docx)).catch(e=>{_docxReady=null;throw e}))}

// ---- file storage (IndexedDB) so the original CV can be opened later ----
const IDB={_db:null,
  open(){return this._db||(this._db=new Promise((res,rej)=>{try{const q=indexedDB.open('cenomi-cv-files',1);q.onupgradeneeded=()=>q.result.createObjectStore('files');q.onsuccess=()=>res(q.result);q.onerror=()=>rej(q.error)}catch(e){rej(e)}}))},
  async tx(mode,fn){const db=await this.open();return new Promise((res,rej)=>{const t=db.transaction('files',mode);const r=fn(t.objectStore('files'));t.oncomplete=()=>res(r&&r.result);t.onerror=()=>rej(t.error)})},
  put(id,blob){return this.tx('readwrite',s=>s.put(blob,String(id)))},
  get(id){return this.tx('readonly',s=>s.get(String(id)))},
  del(id){return this.tx('readwrite',s=>s.delete(String(id)))}
};
const MEMFILES={}; // fallback if IndexedDB is blocked
let _cdb=null,_cas=null;
const NATIVE=/^(application\/pdf|image\/(png|jpe?g|gif|webp))$/;
const b2b64=b=>new Promise((res,rej)=>{const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>res(String(r.result).split(',')[1]);r.onerror=rej;r.readAsDataURL(b)});
async function cloudPut(id,file){
  if(!_cdb||!_cas)return;
  try{
    const native=NATIVE.test(file.type||'');
    const blob=native?file:new Blob([await b2b64(file)],{type:'text/plain'});
    const up=await _cas.upload(blob);
    const old=CVL[id]&&CVL[id].asset;
    CVL[id]={...CVL[id],asset:up.id,b64:!native};save(CV_LS,CVL);
    await _cdb.doc('cvs/'+id).set({...CVL[id]});
    if(old&&old!==up.id){try{await _cas.delete(old)}catch(e){}}
  }catch(e){toast('CV saved on this computer only (cloud upload failed)')}
}
async function cloudGet(id){
  const m=CVL[id];if(!m||!m.asset)return null;
  try{const r=await fetch('/_blob/'+m.asset);if(!r.ok)return null;let b=await r.blob();
    if(m.b64){const t=await b.text();const bin=atob(t.trim());const u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);b=new Blob([u],{type:m.type||''})}
    const f=new File([b],m.name||'CV',{type:m.type||b.type||''});try{await IDB.put(id,f)}catch(e){}return f}catch(e){return null}
}
async function cloudDel(id,meta){if(!_cdb)return;try{await _cdb.doc('cvs/'+id).delete()}catch(e){}if(_cas&&meta&&meta.asset){try{await _cas.delete(meta.asset)}catch(e){}}}
async function makeThumb(file){
  const W=132,H=174;
  const draw=src=>new Promise((res,rej)=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=H;const x=c.getContext('2d');
    x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const sc=W/im.width, sh=Math.min(H,im.height*sc);
    x.drawImage(im,0,0,im.width,sh/sc,0,0,W,sh);
    res(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72));URL.revokeObjectURL(src)};im.onerror=rej;im.src=src});
  try{
    const ext=extOf(file.name||''),type=file.type||'';
    if(/^image\//.test(type)||/^(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|bmp)$/.test(ext))return await draw(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    if(type==='application/pdf'||ext==='pdf'){
      await ensurePdf();
      const pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:await file.arrayBuffer()}).promise;
      const pg=await pdf.getPage(1),v0=pg.getViewport({scale:1}),v=pg.getViewport({scale:W/v0.width});
      const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=W;c.height=Math.min(H,v.height);
      const x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
      await pg.render({canvasContext:x,viewport:v}).promise;
      return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72);
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return null;
}
async function thumbFor(id,file){
  const t=await makeThumb(file);if(!t)return false;
  CVL[id]={...(CVL[id]||{}),thumb:t};save(CV_LS,CVL);
  if(_cdb){try{await _cdb.doc('cvs/'+id).set({...CVL[id]})}catch(e){}}
  return true;
}
async function storeFile(id,file){MEMFILES[id]=file;try{await IDB.put(id,file)}catch(e){}await cloudPut(id,file);
  if(await thumbFor(id,file)){prep();apply()}}
async function getFile(id){try{const b=await IDB.get(id);if(b)return b}catch(e){}if(MEMFILES[id])return MEMFILES[id];const c=await cloudGet(id);if(c)MEMFILES[id]=c;return c}
(async()=>{try{
  if(!window.claude||!claude.use)return;
  _cdb=await claude.use('db');_cas=await claude.use('assets');
  if(!_cdb)return;
  _cdb.collection('cvs').onSnapshot(snap=>{let ch=false;
    snap.docChanges().forEach(c=>{const id=isNaN(+c.doc.id)?c.doc.id:+c.doc.id;
      if(c.type==='removed'){if(CVL[id]){delete CVL[id];delete MEMFILES[id];ch=true}}
      else{const d=c.doc.data();if(d){CVL[id]={...d};ch=true}}});
    if(ch){save(CV_LS,CVL);prep();apply();if(cur!=null)openDr(cur)}});
  // push CVs saved earlier in this browser that aren't in the shared store yet
  if(_cas)for(const id of Object.keys(CVL)){if(!CVL[id].asset){try{const f=await IDB.get(id);if(f)await cloudPut(isNaN(+id)?id:+id,f)}catch(e){}}}
  // build any missing thumbnails for files already stored in this browser
  let made=false;
  for(const id of Object.keys(CVL)){if(CVL[id].thumb)continue;try{const f=await IDB.get(id);if(f&&await thumbFor(isNaN(+id)?id:+id,f))made=true}catch(e){}}
  if(made){prep();apply()}
}catch(e){}})();

// ---- read a file -> {kind,text,previewUrl,html} ----
const extOf=n=>(String(n).match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i)||[,''])[1].toLowerCase();
async function readCv(file){
  const ext=extOf(file.name),type=file.type||'';
  const out={kind:'other',text:'',url:URL.createObjectURL(file),html:''};
  try{
    if(ext==='pdf'||type==='application/pdf'){
      out.kind='pdf';await ensurePdf();
      const pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer())}).promise;
      const lines=[];
      for(let p=1;p<=Math.min(pdf.numPages,6);p++){
        const tc=await (await pdf.getPage(p)).getTextContent();let line='';
        for(const it of tc.items){line+=it.str;if(it.hasEOL){lines.push(line);line=''}else if(it.str&&!/\s$/.test(it.str))line+=' '}
        if(line.trim())lines.push(line);
      }
      out.text=lines.map(l=>l.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    }else if(ext==='docx'){
      out.kind='docx';await ensureDocx();const ab=await file.arrayBuffer();
      out.text=(await mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer:ab})).value;
      out.html=(await mammoth.convertToHtml({arrayBuffer:ab})).value.replace(/<(script|iframe|object)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi,'');
    }else if(/^(txt|rtf|csv|md)$/.test(ext)||type.startsWith('text/')){
      out.kind='text';out.text=(await file.text()).replace(/\{\\[^}]*\}|\\[a-z]+\d* ?/g,' ');
    }else if(type.startsWith('image/')||/^(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|bmp|heic)$/.test(ext)){
      out.kind='image';
    }else if(ext==='doc'){out.kind='doc'}
  }catch(e){out.error=e.message||String(e)}
  out.text=(out.text||'').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/[ \t]+/g,' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g,'\n\n').trim();
  return out;
}

// ---- pull applicant fields out of CV text ----
const SECTION=/^(ԿՐԹՈՒԹՅՈՒՆ|ԿՈՆՏԱԿՏ|ԿԱՊ|ԼԵԶՈՒՆԵՐ|ՀՄՏՈՒԹՅՈՒՆՆԵՐ|ԻՄ ՄԱՍԻՆ|ԱՇԽԱՏԱՆՔԱՅԻՆ|ՓՈՐՁ|ՆՊԱՏԱԿ|ՌԵԶՅՈՒՄԵ|ԻՆՔՆԱԿԵՆՍԱԳՐԱԿԱՆ|ՄԱՍՆԱԳԻՏԱԿԱՆ|ԱՆՁՆԱԿԱՆ|ՀԵՏԱԴԱՐՁ|CURRICULUM|RESUME|CV\b|PROFILE|CONTACT|EDUCATION|EXPERIENCE|SKILLS|LANGUAGES|ABOUT|SUMMARY|OBJECTIVE|РЕЗЮМЕ|ОПЫТ|ОБРАЗОВАНИЕ|НАВЫКИ|КОНТАКТ|О СЕБЕ|ЯЗЫКИ|Կրթություն|Փորձ|Լեզուներ|Հմտություններ|Իմ մասին|Կապ|Կոնտակտ|Education|Experience|Skills|Languages|Contact|Profile|Summary|Опыт|Образование|Навыки|Женщина|Мужчина)/i;
const title=s=>s.split(/(\s+|-)/).map(w=>w.length>1?w[0].toLocaleUpperCase()+w.slice(1).toLocaleLowerCase():w).join('');
function nameFromFile(fn){
  let s=fn.replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i,'').replace(/\(\d+\)/g,' ').replace(/[_\-.]+/g,' ')
    .replace(/\b(cv|resume|résumé|rezume|rezyume|with photo|photo|copy|final|new|updated|\d{2,})\b/gi,' ')
    .replace(/(резюме|ռեզյումե|ինքնակենսագրական|копия)/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  const w=s.split(' ').filter(x=>/^\p{L}{2,}$/u.test(x));
  return w.length>=2&&w.length<=3?title(w.join(' ')):'';
}
function nameFromText(t){
  const lines=t.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,40);
  const ok=l=>l.length<=40&&/^\p{Lu}[\p{L}'’]+(?:[\s-]+\p{Lu}[\p{L}'’.]*){1,2}$/u.test(l)&&!SECTION.test(l)&&!/@|\d/.test(l);
  const sur=/(յան|յանց|ունի|ian|yan|yants|ов|ова|ев|ева|ин|ина|ян|янц|ko|ski|sky)$/iu;
  let best='',bs=-1;
  lines.forEach((l,i)=>{if(!ok(l))return;const w=l.split(/\s+/);let s=40-i;if(w.some(x=>sur.test(x)))s+=40;if(w.length===2)s+=5;if(s>bs){bs=s;best=l}});
  // name split over two lines: "ԷԼԵՆ" / "ՄԱՅԻԼՅԱՆ"
  if(bs<40)for(let i=0;i<lines.length-1;i++){const a=lines[i],b=lines[i+1];
    if(/^\p{Lu}[\p{L}]{1,20}$/u.test(a)&&/^\p{Lu}[\p{L}]{2,25}$/u.test(b)&&(sur.test(b)||sur.test(a))&&!SECTION.test(a)&&!SECTION.test(b)){best=sur.test(b)?a+' '+b:b+' '+a;bs=80;break}}
  return best?(best===best.toLocaleUpperCase()?title(best):best):'';
}
function normPhone(raw){
  let d=raw.replace(/[^\d+]/g,'');const plus=d.startsWith('+');d=d.replace(/\+/g,'');
  if(d.startsWith('00'))d=d.slice(2);
  if(d.startsWith('374')&&d.length===11)return '0'+d.slice(3);
  if(d.length===9&&d[0]==='0')return d;
  if(d.length===8&&/^[1-9]/.test(d)&&!plus)return '0'+d;
  if(plus&&d.length>=10&&d.length<=13)return '+'+d;
  return '';
}
const LANGNAME={RU:'Ռուսերեն',EN:'Անգլերեն',FR:'Ֆրանսերեն',DE:'Գերմաներեն',ES:'Իսպաներեն',FA:'Պարսկերեն'};
const BRANDS=['Zara','Bershka','Massimo Dutti','Pull&Bear','Pull & Bear','Stradivarius','Oysho','Zara Home','Inditex','H&M','Mango','LC Waikiki','Next','Calvin Klein','Love Republic','Zippy','La Senza','ALDO','ECCO','Mavi','Koton','Adidas','Nike','Sixty'];
function parseCv(text,fname){
  const t=text||'',flat=t.replace(/\s+/g,' '),low=flat.toLowerCase(),o={},auto=new Set();
  const set=(k,v)=>{if(v){o[k]=v;auto.add(k)}};
  const em=flat.match(/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/);set('e',em&&em[0].toLowerCase());
  for(const m of flat.matchAll(/\+?\(?\d[\d\s\-()]{6,17}\d/g)){
    if(/^(19|20)\d\d\D+(19|20)\d\d$/.test(m[0].trim()))continue;
    const p=normPhone(m[0]);if(p){set('p',p);break}}
  const dob=flat.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})[./-]((?:19[5-9]|20[01])\d)\b/);
  if(dob)set('b',`${dob[1].padStart(2,'0')}.${dob[2].padStart(2,'0')}.${dob[3]}`);
  else{const ag=flat.match(/(?:տարիք|age|возраст)\s*[:։՝`\-]?\s*(\d{2})\b/i)||flat.match(/\b(\d{2})\s*(?:տարեկան|years old|y\.o\.|лет|года)/i);
    if(ag&&+ag[1]>=14&&+ag[1]<=70)set('b',String(THIS_YEAR-+ag[1]))}
  const byYear=flat.match(/(?:ծննդյան\s*(?:տարեթիվ|ամսաթիվ)|ծնն\.?\s*ամս\.?|date of birth|born|дата рождения)\s*[:։՝\-]?\s*((?:19|20)\d\d)/i);
  if(!o.b&&byYear)set('b',byYear[1]);
  set('n',nameFromText(t)||nameFromFile(fname||''));
  const ad=t.match(/(?:հասցե|բնակության\s*վայր|address|location|адрес|проживает)\s*[:։՝\-]?\s*([^\n@]{3,60})/i);
  if(ad&&!/@/.test(ad[1]))set('a',ad[1].replace(/\s*(հեռ|tel|phone|email|էլ).*$/i,'').trim());
  if(/(համալսարան|university|университет|բակալավր|մագիստր|bachelor|master|ակադեմիա|academy|институт|инստիտուտ|երևանի պետական|ԵՊՀ|ՀԱՊՀ|ՃՇՀԱՀ|ՀՊՏՀ|RAU|ASUE|YSU|высшее)/i.test(flat))set('ed','Համալսարան');
  else if(/(քոլեջ|college|колледж|ուսումնարան|техникум|մասնագիտական ուսումնական)/i.test(flat))set('ed','Քոլեջ');
  else if(/(դպրոց|school|школа|միջնակարգ)/i.test(flat))set('ed','Դպրոց');
  if(/(փորձ\s*չունեմ|աշխատանքային\s*փորձ\s*չ|no (work )?experience|нет опыта|без опыта)/i.test(flat))set('x','Ոչ');
  else if(/(աշխատանքային\s*փորձ|work experience|professional experience|опыт работы|experience)/i.test(flat)&&/(19|20)\d\d/.test(flat))set('x','Այո');
  if(/(այժմ աշխատում եմ|ներկայումս աշխատում|currently work|сейчас работаю|по настоящее время|– present|- present|—\s*present|մինչ\s*օրս)/i.test(flat)&&o.x==='Այո')set('w','Այո');
  const L=langs(flat);if(L.length)set('l',L.map(c=>LANGNAME[c]).join(', '));
  if(/dalma|դալմա/i.test(flat))set('m','Դալմա Մոլ');else if(/mega\s*mall|մեգա\s*մոլ/i.test(flat))set('m','Մեգա Մոլ Արմենիա');else if(/yerevan\s*mall|երևան\s*մոլ/i.test(flat))set('m','Երևան Մոլ');
  if(/(store manager|управляющ|директор магазина|խանութի\s*(?:տնօրեն|մենեջեր)|մենեջեր)/i.test(flat))o.pos='Store Manager';
  const br=BRANDS.filter(b=>low.includes(b.toLowerCase()));
  if(br.length)o.note='Brands in CV: '+[...new Set(br)].join(', ');
  return {o,auto};
}

// ---- review queue ----
let cvQueue=[],cvCur=null;
function fillCvSelects(){
  const mOpts=[['Not specified','Not specified'],...Object.entries(MALL).map(([k,v])=>[k,v])];
  $('cf_m').innerHTML=mOpts.map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${esc(k)}">${esc(v)}</option>`).join('');
  const pOpts=['Sales Consultant',...Object.keys(POS),'Store Manager','Cashier','Not specified'];
  $('cf_pos').innerHTML=[...new Set(pOpts)].map(k=>`<option value="${esc(k)}">${esc(POS[k]||k)}</option>`).join('');
}
function findDup(o){
  const pk=o.p?phoneKey(o.p):'',em=(o.e||'').toLowerCase();
  return data.find(r=>(em&&String(r.e||'').trim().toLowerCase()===em)||(pk.length>=8&&r.pk===pk));
}
async function enqueueCvFiles(files){
  files=[...files].filter(f=>f&&f.size);if(!files.length)return;
  cvQueue.push(...files);if(!cvCur)nextCv();
}
async function nextCv(){
  if(cvCur&&cvCur.read&&cvCur.read.url)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(cvCur.read.url),60000);
  cvCur=null;
  if(!cvQueue.length){$('cvM').classList.remove('show');return}
  const file=cvQueue.shift();cvCur={file};
  $('cvM').classList.add('show');fillCvSelects();
  $('cvQ').textContent=`— ${file.name}${cvQueue.length?` (${cvQueue.length} more in queue)`:''}`;
  $('cvStatus').className='cvstatus';$('cvStatus').textContent='Reading the CV…';$('cvDup').innerHTML='';$('cvAtt').hidden=true;
  $('cvPrev').innerHTML='<div class="none">Loading preview…</div>';
  ['n','p','e','b','a','l','note'].forEach(k=>{$('cf_'+k).value='';$('cf_'+k).classList.remove('auto')});
  ['ed','x','w','idc'].forEach(k=>$('cf_'+k).value='');$('cf_m').value='Not specified';$('cf_pos').value='Sales Consultant';
  const rd=await readCv(file);if(!cvCur||cvCur.file!==file)return;cvCur.read=rd;
  // preview
  if(rd.kind==='pdf')$('cvPrev').innerHTML=`<iframe src="${rd.url}#view=FitH" title="CV preview"></iframe>`;
  else if(rd.kind==='image')$('cvPrev').innerHTML=`<img src="${rd.url}" alt="CV">`;
  else if(rd.kind==='docx'&&rd.html)$('cvPrev').innerHTML=`<div class="docx">${rd.html}</div>`;
  else if(rd.text)$('cvPrev').innerHTML=`<pre class="docx" style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin:0">${esc(rd.text)}</pre>`;
  else $('cvPrev').innerHTML=`<div class="none">No preview for this file type.<br>It will still be saved and can be opened from the applicant card.</div>`;
  $('cvText').textContent=rd.text||'(no text found)';
  const {o,auto}=parseCv(rd.text,file.name);
  if(!o.n)o.n=nameFromFile(file.name);
  ['n','p','e','b','a','l'].forEach(k=>{if(o[k]){$('cf_'+k).value=o[k];if(auto.has(k))$('cf_'+k).classList.add('auto')}});
  ['ed','x','w'].forEach(k=>{if(o[k])$('cf_'+k).value=o[k]});
  if(o.m)$('cf_m').value=o.m;if(o.pos)$('cf_pos').value=o.pos;if(o.note)$('cf_note').value=o.note;
  const found=['n','p','e','b','ed','l'].filter(k=>o[k]).length;
  if(rd.error){$('cvStatus').className='cvstatus warn';$('cvStatus').textContent='Could not read this file automatically ('+rd.error+'). Check your internet connection, or fill in the fields from the preview.'}
  else if(rd.kind==='image'){$('cvStatus').className='cvstatus warn';$('cvStatus').textContent='This CV is a picture — text can’t be read automatically. Type the key details from the preview on the left.'}
  else if(rd.kind==='doc'){$('cvStatus').className='cvstatus warn';$('cvStatus').textContent='Old Word format (.doc) can’t be read here. Fill in the fields manually; the file will still be saved. Tip: save it as .docx or PDF for auto-reading.'}
  else if(!rd.text||rd.text.length<40){$('cvStatus').className='cvstatus warn';$('cvStatus').textContent='This PDF looks scanned (no text inside). Fill in the fields from the preview.'}
  else $('cvStatus').textContent=`Read ✓ — ${found} field${found===1?'':'s'} filled automatically (green). Please check before adding.`;
  showDup();
}
function formVals(){const v={};['n','p','e','b','a','l','m','pos','ed','x','w','idc','note'].forEach(k=>v[k]=$('cf_'+k).value.trim());return v}
function showDup(){
  const d=findDup(formVals());cvCur&&(cvCur.dup=d||null);
  $('cvAtt').hidden=!d;
  $('cvDup').innerHTML=d?`<div class="cvdup">Looks like an existing applicant: <a href="#" id="cvDupOpen">${esc(d.n)}</a> (${d.t.slice(0,10)}, ${esc(MALL[d.m]||d.m||'')}) — same ${d.pk&&phoneKey($('cf_p').value)===d.pk?'phone':'email'}. You can attach this CV to them instead.</div>`:'';
  const a=$('cvDupOpen');if(a)a.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();openDr(d.id)};
}
['cf_p','cf_e'].forEach(id=>$(id).addEventListener('change',showDup));
function nowStr(){const d=new Date(),p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth()+1)}-${p(d.getDate())} ${p(d.getHours())}:${p(d.getMinutes())}`}
async function saveCvFile(id,file,text){
  CVL[id]={...(CVL[id]&&CVL[id].asset?{asset:CVL[id].asset,b64:CVL[id].b64}:{}),name:file.name,type:file.type||'',size:file.size,text:(text||'').slice(0,20000),date:nowStr()};
  save(CV_LS,CVL);await storeFile(id,file);
}
$('cvAdd').onclick=async()=>{
  if(!cvCur||!cvCur.read)return;const v=formVals();
  if(!v.n){toast('Enter the applicant’s name');$('cf_n').focus();return}
  const id=Math.max(300000,...data.map(r=>+r.id||0))+1;
  const rec={id,t:nowStr(),n:v.n,b:v.b,p:v.p,m:v.m,a:v.a,e:v.e,ed:v.ed,pos:v.pos,x:v.x,w:v.w,l:v.l,idc:v.idc,src:'cv',en:'Added from CV file: '+cvCur.file.name};
  extra.push(rec);save(LS_EXTRA,extra);
  if(v.note)setRev(id,{note:v.note});
  await saveCvFile(id,cvCur.file,cvCur.read.text);
  prep();fillSelects();apply();toast(`${v.n} added ✓`);nextCv();
};
$('cvAtt').onclick=async()=>{
  if(!cvCur||!cvCur.dup)return;const d=cvCur.dup,v=formVals();
  await saveCvFile(d.id,cvCur.file,cvCur.read.text);
  if(v.note){const n=R(d.id).note||'';if(!n.includes(v.note))setRev(d.id,{note:(n?n+'\n':'')+v.note})}
  prep();apply();toast(`CV attached to ${d.n} ✓`);if(cur===d.id)openDr(d.id);nextCv();
};
$('cvSkip').onclick=()=>nextCv();
$('cvX').onclick=()=>{cvQueue=[];nextCv()};
$('bAddCv').onclick=()=>$('fCv').click();
$('fCv').onchange=e=>{enqueueCvFiles(e.target.files);e.target.value=''};

// ---- attach a CV to the open applicant ----
async function attachToCurrent(file){
  if(cur==null||!file)return;const r=data.find(x=>x.id===cur);
  toast('Reading CV…');const rd=await readCv(file);
  await saveCvFile(cur,file,rd.text);
  if(rd.text&&r&&r.src==='cv'){ // fill blanks of records created here
    const {o}=parseCv(rd.text,file.name);const x=extra.find(e=>e.id===cur);
    if(x){['p','e','b','a','ed','x','l'].forEach(k=>{if(!x[k]&&o[k])x[k]=o[k]});save(LS_EXTRA,extra)}
  }
  prep();apply();openDr(cur);toast('CV attached ✓');
  setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(rd.url),60000);
}
$('fCvOne').onchange=e=>{attachToCurrent(e.target.files[0]);e.target.value=''};

// ---- drawer CV section ----
function cvSection(r){
  let h='<div class="lbl">CV</div><div class="cvbox" id="cvBox">';
  if(r.cv){
    h+=`<div class="cvfiles">${r.cv.files.map(f=>`<span class="cvfile" title="${esc(f)}">📎 ${esc(f)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`;
    h+=`<div class="cvrow"><a class="btn primary" href="${esc(r.cv.link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Opens the original email in Outlook (HR mailbox) — click the attachment there to view it">✉ Open CV in Outlook</a></div>`;
    h+=`<div class="small">Summary read from the email CV:</div><pre class="cvtxt">${esc(r.cv.text)}</pre>`;
  }
  if(r.cvLocal){
    const c=r.cvLocal;
    h+=`<div class="cvfiles"><span class="cvfile" title="${esc(c.name)}">📄 ${esc(c.name)} · ${Math.max(1,Math.round((c.size||0)/1024))} KB · ${esc((c.date||'').slice(0,10))}</span></div>`;
    h+=`<div class="cvrow"><button class="btn primary" id="cvOpen">Open file</button><button class="btn" id="cvRepl">Replace</button><button class="btn" id="cvDel">Remove</button></div>`;
    if(c.text)h+=`<details${r.cv?'':' open'}><summary class="small">Text from the CV</summary><pre class="cvtxt">${esc(c.text)}</pre></details>`;
  }
  if(!r.cv&&!r.cvLocal)h+=`<div class="cvhint">No CV yet.</div><div class="cvrow"><button class="btn" id="cvAttach">📎 Attach CV file</button><span class="cvhint">or drop a file here</span></div>`;
  else if(!r.cvLocal)h+=`<div class="cvrow"><button class="btn" id="cvAttach">📎 Attach a file</button><span class="cvhint">or drop it here — saves a copy in this browser</span></div>`;
  return h+'</div>';
}
function wireCvSection(){
  const r=data.find(x=>x.id===cur);if(!r)return;
  if($('cvAttach'))$('cvAttach').onclick=()=>$('fCvOne').click();
  if($('cvRepl'))$('cvRepl').onclick=()=>$('fCvOne').click();
  if($('cvDel'))$('cvDel').onclick=async()=>{if(!confirm('Remove the saved CV file for '+r.n+'?'))return;const _m=CVL[r.id];delete CVL[r.id];save(CV_LS,CVL);delete MEMFILES[r.id];try{await IDB.del(r.id)}catch(e){}await cloudDel(r.id,_m);prep();apply();openDr(r.id)};
  if($('cvOpen'))$('cvOpen').onclick=async()=>{
    const w=window.open('','_blank');const b=await getFile(r.id);
    if(!b){if(w)w.close();toast('File not found in this browser — it was saved on another computer or browser data was cleared');return}
    const u=URL.createObjectURL(b);
    if(_dl){if(w)w.close();saveBlob(r.cvLocal.name,b)}else if(w&&/pdf|image|text/.test(b.type||'')){w.location.href=u}else{if(w)w.close();const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=r.cvLocal.name;a.click()}
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),120000)};
}
const _openCv=openDr;openDr=function(id){_openCv(id);const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id);let s=$('dCv');if(s&&r){s.innerHTML=cvSection(r);wireCvSection()}};

// ---- drag & drop anywhere ----
let dragN=0;const isFiles=e=>[...(e.dataTransfer&&e.dataTransfer.types||[])].includes('Files');
const inDrawer=e=>cur!=null&&$('dr').classList.contains('open')&&$('dr').contains(e.target);
document.addEventListener('dragenter',e=>{if(!isFiles(e))return;e.preventDefault();dragN++;if(!inDrawer(e))$('dropOv').classList.add('show')});
document.addEventListener('dragover',e=>{if(!isFiles(e))return;e.preventDefault();const d=inDrawer(e);$('dropOv').classList.toggle('show',!d);const b=$('cvBox');if(b)b.classList.toggle('drag',d)});
document.addEventListener('dragleave',e=>{if(!isFiles(e))return;dragN=Math.max(0,dragN-1);if(!dragN){$('dropOv').classList.remove('show');const b=$('cvBox');if(b)b.classList.remove('drag')}});
document.addEventListener('drop',e=>{if(!isFiles(e))return;e.preventDefault();dragN=0;$('dropOv').classList.remove('show');const b=$('cvBox');if(b)b.classList.remove('drag');
  const fs=[...e.dataTransfer.files];if(!fs.length)return;
  if(inDrawer(e)&&!$('cvM').classList.contains('show')){attachToCurrent(fs[0]);if(fs.length>1)enqueueCvFiles(fs.slice(1))}else enqueueCvFiles(fs)});

// ---- hook into the existing list ----
const _prepCv=prep;prep=function(){_prepCv();data.forEach(r=>{r.cvLocal=CVL[r.id]||null})};

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('cvM').classList.contains('show')){e.stopImmediatePropagation();$('cvX').click()}},true);

// ================= CV snapshots (full CV text pulled from the hr.armenia mailbox attachments) =================
const CV_IMG=/\.(jpe?g|png|heic|webp)\b|cv image|photo/i;
function cvSnapSource(r){
  const full=r.cv&&CV_FULL[r.id];
  if(full)return {text:full,flag:''};
  if(r.cv){
    const files=r.cv.files.join(' ');
    const flag=CV_IMG.test(files)?'This CV was sent as a picture, so only a summary is shown. Open it in Outlook to see the image.'
      :'The attached file could not be read (scanned or unsupported format), so only a summary is shown. Open it in Outlook for the original.';
    return {text:r.cv.text,flag};
  }
  if(r.cvLocal&&r.cvLocal.text&&r.cvLocal.text.length>40)return {text:r.cvLocal.text,flag:''};
  return null;
}
function cvPaper(text,fallbackName){
  const lines=String(text||'').replace(/\r/g,'').split('\n');
  const isHead=s=>{const t=s.replace(/\([^)]*\)/g,'').trim();return t.length>1&&t.length<=48&&/[A-Za-zА-Яа-яЁёԱ-Ֆա-և]/.test(t)&&!/[a-zа-яёա-և]/.test(t)&&!/^[•\-*]/.test(t)&&!/[@\d]{3,}/.test(t)};
  let h='',i=0;
  while(i<lines.length&&!lines[i].trim())i++;
  const first=(lines[i]||'').trim();
  if(first&&isHead(first)||first&&first.length<60&&!/^[•(]/.test(first)){h+=`<div class="pn">${esc(first)}</div>`;i++;
    while(i<lines.length&&lines[i].trim()&&!isHead(lines[i].trim())){h+=`<div class="ps">${esc(lines[i].trim())}</div>`;i++}}
  else if(fallbackName)h+=`<div class="pn">${esc(fallbackName)}</div>`;
  for(;i<lines.length;i++){
    const s=lines[i].trim();if(!s)continue;
    if(/^\(.*\)$/.test(s)){h+=`<div class="pnote">${esc(s.slice(1,-1))}</div>`;continue}
    if(isHead(s)){h+=`<div class="ph">${esc(s)}</div>`;continue}
    if(/^[•\-*]\s*/.test(s)){h+=`<div class="pb">${esc(s.replace(/^[•\-*]\s*/,''))}</div>`;continue}
    const m=s.length<170&&s.match(/^(.+?)( — | \| )(.+)$/);
    if(m){h+=`<div class="pi"><b>${esc(m[1])}</b>${esc(m[2])}${esc(m[3])}</div>`;continue}
    h+=`<div class="pp">${esc(s)}</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="paper">${h}</div>`;
}
// list of applicants with a snapshot, in the current table order
const snapList=()=>view.filter(r=>cvSnapSource(r));
let snapCur=null;
function openSnap(id){
  const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id);const src=r&&cvSnapSource(r);if(!src)return;
  snapCur=id;
  $('snapT').textContent=r.n;
  const L=snapList(),i=L.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);
  $('snapS').textContent=[POS[r.pos]||r.pos,MALL[r.m]||r.m,r.t.slice(0,10),i>=0?`CV ${i+1} of ${L.length}`:''].filter(x=>x&&x!=='Not specified').join(' · ');
  $('snapB').innerHTML=(src.flag?`<div class="snapflag" style="max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 10px">${esc(src.flag)}</div>`:'')+cvPaper(src.text,r.n);
  $('snapB').scrollTop=0;
  const ol=$('snapOL');if(r.cv&&r.cv.link){ol.href=r.cv.link;ol.style.display=''}else ol.style.display='none';
  $('snapP').disabled=!(i>0);$('snapN').disabled=!(i>=0&&i<L.length-1);
  $('snapM').classList.add('show');
}
function snapStep(d){const L=snapList(),i=L.findIndex(x=>x.id===snapCur),n=L[i+d];if(n){openSnap(n.id);if(cur!=null)openDr(n.id)}}
function closeSnap(){$('snapM').classList.remove('show');snapCur=null}
$('snapX').onclick=closeSnap;
$('snapP').onclick=()=>snapStep(-1);$('snapN').onclick=()=>snapStep(1);
$('snapCard').onclick=()=>{const id=snapCur;closeSnap();openDr(id)};
$('snapM').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='snapM')closeSnap()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!$('snapM').classList.contains('show'))return;
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.stopImmediatePropagation();closeSnap()}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();snapStep(1)}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();snapStep(-1)}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'||e.key==='j'||e.key==='k')e.stopImmediatePropagation()},true);
// click the "📄 CV" tag in the table → snapshot
$('tb').addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('.cvt');if(!t)return;e.stopImmediatePropagation();const id=+t.closest('tr').dataset.id;openSnap(id)},true);
// drawer: snapshot preview above the CV box
const _openSnapDr=openDr;openDr=function(id){_openSnapDr(id);const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id);const box=$('cvBox');if(!r||!box)return;
  const src=cvSnapSource(r);if(!src)return;
  const w=document.createElement('div');
  w.innerHTML=(src.flag?`<div class="snapflag">${esc(src.flag)}</div>`:'')+`<div class="snapwrap" title="Click to open the full CV snapshot">${cvPaper(src.text,r.n)}<span class="snapmore">⤢ Open full CV</span></div>`;
  box.prepend(w);const sw=w.querySelector('.snapwrap');sw.onclick=()=>openSnap(id);if(sw.scrollHeight<=sw.clientHeight+2)sw.classList.add('short');
  const sum=box.querySelector('pre.cvtxt');if(sum&&r.cv){const sm=sum.previousElementSibling;if(sm&&sm.classList.contains('small'))sm.remove();sum.remove()}
};

// ================= Real CV snapshots from the original files =================
const CV_SIZE={"100004": [210712], "100005": [38601], "100007": [103703], "100009": [26536], "100011": [650394], "100013": [584545], "100014": [476073], "100015": [370317], "100016": [51748, 573727], "100020": [130534], "100021": [259334], "100023": [107839], "100024": [138062], "100026": [186834], "100029": [135255], "100031": [128505], "100035": [169872], "100039": [38051], "100041": [67330], "100042": [22977], "100043": [102294], "100044": [84924], "100046": [311], "100047": [85084], "100049": [41012], "100053": [94532], "100055": [125799], "100056": [2026792], "100057": [572612], "100058": [2375486], "100060": [1623974], "100062": [150431], "100063": [113824], "100064": [121678], "100066": [1651442], "100067": [49562], "100068": [13670], "100069": [477937], "100070": [915955], "100071": [133932], "100072": [135793], "100074": [134817], "100076": [753617], "100078": [174004], "100079": [243984], "100082": [115600], "100084": [2363144], "100085": [443136]};
const normFn=s=>String(s||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g,'').replace(/\((cv image|photo[^)]*)\)/g,'').replace(/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}\s*$/,'').replace(/\(\d+\)/g,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9Ѐ-ӿԱ-և]+/g,'');
const GENERIC=/^(cv|cvv|resume|rezume|document\d*|cvpdf)$/;
function matchCvFile(file){
  const emailApps=data.filter(r=>r.cv);
  const bySize=emailApps.filter(r=>(CV_SIZE[r.id]||[]).includes(file.size));
  if(bySize.length===1)return bySize[0].id;
  const n=normFn(file.name);if(!n||GENERIC.test(n))return null;
  const hits=emailApps.filter(r=>r.cv.files.some(f=>{const m=normFn(f);return m&&!GENERIC.test(m)&&(m===n||(m.length>8&&(n.startsWith(m)||m.startsWith(n))))}));
  return hits.length===1?hits[0].id:null;
}
const _enqueueOrig=enqueueCvFiles;
enqueueCvFiles=async function(files){
  files=[...files].filter(f=>f&&f.size>0&&!/^\./.test(f.name));
  const rest=[];let ok=0;
  for(const f of files){const id=matchCvFile(f);
    if(id!=null&&!(CVL[id]&&CVL[id].size===f.size)){await saveCvFile(id,f,'');ok++}
    else if(id!=null)ok++;
    else rest.push(f)}
  if(ok){prep();apply();if(cur!=null)openDr(cur)}
  toast(ok?`${ok} CV file${ok>1?'s':''} matched to applicants ✓${rest.length?` · ${rest.length} to review`:''}`:'No automatic match — review each file');
  if(rest.length)_enqueueOrig(rest);
};
// render the original file (pdf pages / image / docx) into an element
async function renderReal(el,id,{pages=6,width=760}={}){
  if(CV_SNAP[id]&&!CVL[id]){el.innerHTML=CV_SNAP[id].slice(0,pages).map(s=>`<img class="realpg" src="${s}" alt="CV">`).join('');return true}
  const f=await getFile(id);if(!f)return false;
  const ext=extOf(f.name||(CVL[id]&&CVL[id].name)||''),type=f.type||'';
  el.innerHTML='<div class="small" style="padding:20px;text-align:center">Loading CV…</div>';
  try{
    if(ext==='pdf'||type==='application/pdf'){
      await ensurePdf();const pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer())}).promise;
      el.innerHTML='';const dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
      for(let p=1;p<=Math.min(pdf.numPages,pages);p++){
        const pg=await pdf.getPage(p),v1=pg.getViewport({scale:1}),sc=width/v1.width,vp=pg.getViewport({scale:sc*dpr});
        const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=vp.width;c.height=vp.height;c.className='realpg';
        await pg.render({canvasContext:c.getContext('2d'),viewport:vp}).promise;el.appendChild(c);
      }
      if(pdf.numPages>pages)el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="small" style="text-align:center">+${pdf.numPages-pages} more page(s) — use “Open file”</div>`);
      return true;
    }
    if(type.startsWith('image/')||/^(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|bmp)$/.test(ext)){
      const u=URL.createObjectURL(f);el.innerHTML=`<img class="realpg" src="${u}" alt="CV">`;return true}
    if(ext==='docx'){await ensureDocx();const h=(await mammoth.convertToHtml({arrayBuffer:await f.arrayBuffer()})).value.replace(/<(script|iframe|object)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi,'');
      el.innerHTML=`<div class="paper docpaper">${h}</div>`;return true}
    if(/^(txt|md|csv)$/.test(ext)||type.startsWith('text/')){el.innerHTML=cvPaper(await f.text());return true}
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="snapflag">This file type (.${esc(ext)}) can’t be shown in the browser. Use “Open file” to open it.</div>`;return true;
  }catch(e){if(/pdf/i.test(ext+type)){const u=URL.createObjectURL(f);el.innerHTML=`<iframe class="realpg" src="${u}#view=FitH" style="width:${width}px;height:${Math.round(width*1.35)}px;border:0" title="CV"></iframe>`;return true}
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="snapflag">Could not render this file (${esc(e.message||e)}).</div>`;return true}
}
const hasReal=r=>!!(r.cvLocal||CV_SNAP[r.id]);
// snapshot modal: real file first, text fallback
const _openSnapText=openSnap;
openSnap=async function(id){
  const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!r)return;
  if(!hasReal(r)){_openSnapText(id);if(r.cv)$('snapB').insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<div class="snapflag" style="max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 10px">Original file not loaded yet — this is the text version. Drop the CV files (or use 📂 Load CV folder) to see the real CV here.</div>`);return}
  snapCur=id;$('snapT').textContent=r.n;
  const L=snapList(),i=L.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);
  $('snapS').textContent=[POS[r.pos]||r.pos,MALL[r.m]||r.m,r.t.slice(0,10),i>=0?`CV ${i+1} of ${L.length}`:''].filter(x=>x&&x!=='Not specified').join(' · ');
  const ol=$('snapOL');if(r.cv&&r.cv.link){ol.href=r.cv.link;ol.style.display=''}else ol.style.display='none';
  $('snapP').disabled=!(i>0);$('snapN').disabled=!(i>=0&&i<L.length-1);
  $('snapM').classList.add('show');$('snapB').scrollTop=0;
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='realwrap';$('snapB').innerHTML='';$('snapB').appendChild(box);
  const w=Math.min(760,$('snapB').clientWidth-24);
  await renderReal(box,id,{pages:6,width:w});
};
const _snapSrcOrig=cvSnapSource;
cvSnapSource=r=>_snapSrcOrig(r)||(r.cvLocal?{text:'',flag:''}:null);
// drawer: real first page thumbnail
const _openDrReal=openDr;openDr=function(id){_openDrReal(id);const r=data.find(x=>x.id===id);const box=$('cvBox');if(!r||!box||!hasReal(r))return;
  const old=box.querySelector('.snapwrap');const flag=old&&old.parentElement.querySelector('.snapflag');if(flag)flag.remove();
  const w=document.createElement('div');w.className='snapwrap realthumb';w.title='Click to open the CV';w.innerHTML='<div class="realwrap"></div><span class="snapmore">⤢ Open CV</span>';
  if(old)old.replaceWith(w);else box.prepend(w);
  w.onclick=()=>openSnap(id);
  renderReal(w.querySelector('.realwrap'),id,{pages:1,width:Math.max(260,box.clientWidth-24)});
};
// folder loader
$('bCvDir').onclick=()=>$('fCvDir').click();
$('fCvDir').onchange=e=>{const fs=[...e.target.files].filter(f=>/\.(pdf|docx?|png|jpe?g|webp|txt)$/i.test(f.name));e.target.value='';if(fs.length)enqueueCvFiles(fs);else toast('No CV files in that folder')};

// ---- shared storage: statuses, ratings, notes and added applicants live in the artifact database,
// so they survive every update of this page and are the same for everyone the link is shared with ----
let _sdb=null,_sState='connecting',_sTimer=null;const _sSent={rev:{},app:{}};
const SYNC_TXT=()=>_sState==='on'?'☁ comments & statuses saved for everyone':_sState==='connecting'?'connecting to shared storage…':_sState==='ro'?'view-only — ask the owner for edit access to save changes':'⚠ shared storage unavailable — changes saved in this browser only';
function setSync(s){if(_sState===s)return;_sState=s;try{render()}catch(e){}}
const _J=o=>JSON.stringify(o??null);
const _idOf=k=>isNaN(+k)?k:+k;
function queueShared(){if(!_sdb)return;clearTimeout(_sTimer);_sTimer=setTimeout(flushShared,700)}
async function flushShared(){
  if(!_sdb)return;
  const jobs=[];
  for(const [id,v] of Object.entries(rev)){const j=_J(v);if(_sSent.rev[id]!==j){_sSent.rev[id]=j;jobs.push(['reviews/'+id,v||{},'rev',id])}}
  for(const r of extra){const id=String(r.id),j=_J(r);if(_sSent.app[id]!==j){_sSent.app[id]=j;jobs.push(['applicants/'+id,r,'app',id])}}
  for(const [path,v,kind,id] of jobs){
    try{await _sdb.doc(path).set(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)))}
    catch(e){delete _sSent[kind][id];const c=e&&e.code;
      clearTimeout(_sTimer);
      if(c==='unavailable'||c==='resource_exhausted'||!c){_sTimer=setTimeout(flushShared,4000+Math.random()*3000);return}
      if(c==='quota_exceeded'){setSync('off');toast('Shared storage is full — export a backup');return}
      setSync('ro');{const t=$('toast');t.textContent='Not saved for the team: you have view-only access. Ask the owner to make you a Contributor.';t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(t._t);t._t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),8000)}return}
  }
  if(jobs.length&&_sState!=='on')setSync('on');
}
function refreshAfterRemote(changedIds){
  try{localStorage.setItem(LS_REV,JSON.stringify(rev));localStorage.setItem(LS_EXTRA,JSON.stringify(extra))}catch(e){}
  prep();fillSelects();apply();
  if(cur!=null&&changedIds.has(String(cur))&&document.activeElement!==$('dNote'))openDr(cur);
}
(async()=>{
  const fail=setTimeout(()=>{if(_sState==='connecting')setSync('off')},12000);
  try{
    if(!window.claude||!claude.use){clearTimeout(fail);setSync('off');return}
    _sdb=await claude.use('db');
    if(!_sdb){clearTimeout(fail);setSync('off');return}
    let firstRev=true,firstApp=true;
    const localRev={...rev},localExtra=extra.slice();
    _sdb.collection('reviews').onSnapshot(snap=>{
      clearTimeout(fail);const ch=new Set();
      snap.docChanges().forEach(c=>{const id=c.doc.id;ch.add(id);
        if(c.type==='removed'){delete rev[id];delete _sSent.rev[id]}
        else{const d=c.doc.data()||{};rev[id]=d;_sSent.rev[id]=_J(d)}});
      if(firstRev){firstRev=false;
        // migrate notes made earlier in this browser: keep cloud values, add anything the cloud doesn't have yet
        for(const [id,v] of Object.entries(localRev)){if(!v)continue;const c=rev[id];
          if(!c)rev[id]=v;
          else{const m={...c};let add=false;for(const k of Object.keys(v)){if((m[k]===undefined||m[k]===''||m[k]===0)&&v[k]){m[k]=v[k];add=true}}
            if(v.note&&c.note&&c.note!==v.note&&!c.note.includes(v.note)){m.note=c.note+'\n'+v.note;add=true}
            if(add)rev[id]=m}}
        if(_sState==='connecting')setSync('on');queueShared()}
      refreshAfterRemote(ch);
    },e=>{setSync('off')});
    _sdb.collection('applicants').onSnapshot(snap=>{
      const ch=new Set();const byId=new Map(extra.map(r=>[String(r.id),r]));
      snap.docChanges().forEach(c=>{const id=c.doc.id;ch.add(id);
        if(c.type==='removed'){byId.delete(id);delete _sSent.app[id]}
        else{const d=c.doc.data()||{};d.id=_idOf(d.id??id);byId.set(id,d);_sSent.app[id]=_J(d)}});
      if(firstApp){firstApp=false;for(const r of localExtra){if(!byId.has(String(r.id)))byId.set(String(r.id),r)}queueShared()}
      extra=[...byId.values()];
      refreshAfterRemote(ch);
    },e=>{});
  }catch(e){clearTimeout(fail);setSync('off')}
})();

prep();fillSelects();apply();
</script>

</body></html>
